note: Rejudged 2026-10-17 after 7af5edbb7f. RFC 4456 Section 8 read in rfc/full/rfc4456.txt: "When an RR reflects a route, it MUST prepend the local CLUSTER_ID to the CLUSTER_LIST.  If the CLUSTER_LIST is empty, it MUST create a new one." The commit changed checkReflectorWithdrawal (both tags) only in the text of its final Established failure, now wrapped by interoplab.WithSearchedOutput, which returns a non-nil error for the same cause; no condition moved. The interop positive still requires the exact token 800A04<3 octets>02, a newly created four-byte CLUSTER_LIST holding Ze's configured cluster-id (the empty-list clause), and the negative still requires the attribute-free byte-exact withdrawal. The prepend-onto-existing clause stays proven by the unchanged unit covers: TestReactorForwardRRInjects requires exact [1.2.3.2] and TestReactorForwardRRPreservesOriginator exact [1.2.3.2,5.5.5.5], so replacement, append, omission and a wrong local id all fail. The interop units carry no discrimination record and were not rerun for this failure-text change. Verdict unchanged.
